name: Naze ka Kanojo ga Boku ni Ecchi o Sematte Kuru Ken
original_name: 何故か彼女がボクにエッチを迫ってくる件
source: Karasaki Takuto is a gamer that mostly spends his time gaming and minding his own business. When one day his class mate Mihara Yuu invites him to a room that is no longer in use. She takes the lead and does sexual acts with Karasaki Takuto. She says its a secret between two people but her friends find out and also want to join in on the fun.
translation: 唐崎拓斗是个游戏宅，大部分时间都在打游戏、过自己的日子。一天，同班同学三原优邀请他前往一间已经废弃的房间。她主动带领拓斗，与他发生了性关系。她说这是两人之间的秘密，但她的朋友们得知后，也想加入这场快乐。
